data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism of global load-balancing in large services (SRC_001) contradicts the resilience of decentralized networks if the 'Fragility of the Commons' (SCR_001) is present, meaning the decentralized network's perceived independence is actually a hidden dependence on a single shared infrastructure provider; this is refuted if the decentralized nodes maintain true physical and provider-level heterogeneity.
